name: tdd-toolkit
description: Test-Driven Development toolkit: a chat agent that drives the red-green-refactor loop, and a skill/script to run the test suite from chat or the terminal.

agents.name: TDD Agent
agents.description: Clarifies requirements, drafts failing tests first, runs them, implements minimal code, and loops until all tests pass.

skills.name: tdd-loop
skills.description: Auto-detects the project's test runner and prints a red/green pass-fail report.
